name: Orbital disc
description: Wireframe disc with rippled grid and orbiting satellite inside an octagonal frame.

name: Ring dial
description: Concentric rings pulsing in cascade, rotating tick ring and sweeping needle.

name: Twin spheres
description: Two counter-rotating wireframe globes linked by a travelling pulse.
motion: Continuous 3D rotation, pulse along a curve

name: Wave terrain
description: Perspective wireframe terrain with waves flowing toward the viewer.

name: Signal scope
description: Oscilloscope trace with blinking cursor, status LED and level bars.
motion: Looping trace scroll, blink, level bars

name: Contact dial
description: Concentric-ring dial with a slowly rotating tick ring and static needle.
usedIn: Nowhere. Replaced by LIB-05 in v3 Contact

name: Soft LED
description: Round orange status LED with a soft fade pulse.
usedIn: v3 hero, Work cards, Contact, octagonal frame

name: Data meters
description: Experience ticks, CEFR scale and tools bars that display real data.

name: Design unit
description: Retro device with an oscilloscope screen, keypad, knobs and vents.

name: Six-axis jack
description: Six-armed cross with one orange hole, rotating inside corner brackets.

name: Data bars
description: Row of orange and yellow bars gently rising and falling.

name: Tools marquee
description: Infinite band of tool names separated by orange squares.
motion: Continuous horizontal scroll, pauses on hover

name: Typewriter caret
description: Label typed letter by letter once, followed by a blinking caret.

name: Square LED
description: Hard-edged orange status square with a stepped blink.

name: Scroll reveal
description: Modules fade and rise 16px the first time they enter the view.
usedIn: v1 section heads, grids and case files
motion: One-time fade and rise on scroll

name: Hover invert cell
description: Spec cell that flips to an orange fill with black text on hover or focus.
motion: Colour inversion on hover or focus (no idle motion)

name: Interactive 3D mesh
description: Perspective wireframe disc with drag, inertia, zoom, reset, keyboard and live readout.
motion: User-driven orbit and zoom with inertia, auto-spin when idle
